description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Khalni Gem.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Khalni Gem.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
